Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If a vampire who is full to capacity plays Tongue of the Serpent
as a strike, and the opposing minion strikes hands for one, what
happens?
Does the "Stolen Blood" overflow into the Blood Bank before
damage resolution (thus the vampire still loses 1 blood in combat),
or can it be used to fill the vampire back up after damage?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The former. See the example in 6.4.5 illustrating this point.
